label: class_g_07_home_01
text: Put away your phones. It is time to begin our last\nclass together.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_02
text: Home economics is the study of life’s necessities,\nbut looking back on our time together, I realize\r\nthat I focused almost entirely on food.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_03
text: I hope it is not too late to shift to a discussion of\nclothing—another necessity—in our last class.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_04
text: As I’m sure you are aware, our academy has an\nair of freedom about it.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_05
text:
We provide uniforms for each season to
accommodate the diverse climate of Paldea.\c
However, students are free to wear whichever
style they wish whenever they please.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_06
text: You should all have received four sets of tops\nand bottoms—one each for spring, summer, fall,\r\nand winter—when the academy accepted you.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_07
text: If, by chance, you were not aware of this, you\nmay wish to peruse your wardrobe.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_08
text: As long as you wear our school uniform, the rest\nof your ensemble need not be school-issued.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_09
text: This includes your bag or your hat, if you choose\nto wear one. You are even free to style your hair\r\nhowever you wish.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_10
text: Mr. Salvatore’s hairstyle, for example, would\nalmost certainly have been against school rules\r\nwhen I was a boy.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_11
text: That reminds me...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_12
text: There is one more thing you all like to decorate,\nwhich—I must say—I find quite charming.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_select_01
text: Our classroom desks?

label: class_g_07_select_02
text: Our dorm rooms?

label: class_g_07_select_03
text: Our Rotom Phones?

label: class_g_07_home_answer_01
text:
No, not that. I speak of something smaller and far
more adorable...\c
More importantly, your desk is not different or
customized in the slightest![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_answer_02
text:
No, not that. I speak of something smaller and far
more adorable...\c
More importantly, how you decorate the interior
of your dorm rooms is none of my business![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_answer_03
text: Perfectly correct! That’s the adorable little thing\nI was speaking of! Ohhh, it interests me so![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_13
text: I must admit that I am fascinated by Rotom\nPhones and how to customize them![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_14
text: What’s that...? How very intriguing!\c\nSo there’s a shop called Delibird Presents, where\nyou can purchase cases for your Rotom Phones![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_15
text: I thank you for that useful bit of information...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_16
text: I shall have to go myself first thing tomorrow to\nget an adorable case of my own liking.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_17
text: Forgive me... I seem to have gotten a little\ncarried away with this small talk.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_18
text: Ahem. As this class known as home economics\nnears its end, I offer these final words to you who\r\nhave been honing everyday life skills with me.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_19
text: My field of study is not so decisive as the likes\nof mathematics, for instance, where test scores\r\nmight play a part in deciding your future.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_20
text: However, as you go on to cook for yourselves,\nto take care of your Pokémon, to decide what to\r\nwear in the morning when you awaken...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_21
text:
I would be honored if what I have taught you
serves to smoothen out and enrich your lives,
even if only a little.\c
This sentiment was imparted to me by Mr. Hassel
and his particular outlook on such matters.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_22
text: I thank you all from the bottom of my heart for\nseeing this class through to the end.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

label: class_g_07_home_23
text: Our time together has come to a close for today.\nPrepare to do your best on our final exam.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
